sharp_interaction_hierarchy.uniform_result: R(n)=(log(n)+0.5*log(log(n)))/log(3*sqrt(3)/2)+O(1), for both independent positive weights and actual prime bases.
sharp_interaction_hierarchy.scope: Finite exact moment, strict-boundary, orbit and parameter controls. The uniform asymptotic theorem rests on the written proof and Stirling estimates, not a numerical fit. The finite upper bound is sufficient, not the exact minimum R(n). No novelty or unranking speedup is certified.

arbitrary_quotient_boundary.scope: The exact monomial-plus-one-binomial presentations have two initial ideals. These are a boundary on extending the free-lattice theorem to arbitrary quotients, not a new universal Groebner-basis algorithm.

sparse_prefix_cones.scope: Exact prefix-cone certificates replay a strict rational center and use rigorous interval signs, validated against exact prime products. This is separate from the CLI rank auditor and adds no certified fast-unranking range. Uniform sharp arity and exact inversion rest on the written proof; novelty remains unresolved.

primary_toolkit_comparison.scope: Positive primary-source identification: the auxiliary distribution and factorial moments are established Dirichlet-multinomial specializations; both differing corner cuts obey the published Borel-fixed condition in the same coordinate order. These tests do not establish novelty of the sharp support law.

prefix_boundary_conventions.scope: The n=1 reconstruction parameter is zero, but no positive-weight facet exists. Global facet maxima are stated for n>=2; a one-dimensional ambient cone can still have no positive facet.
